methodology: Confidence % is a composite score (exec engagement 30%, usage trend 30%, support escalations 20%, contractual complexity 20%). Buckets: Low < 40%, Medium 40-69%, High >= 70%. ARR shown as committed ARR for nearest 12 months. Dates are contract termination (no auto-renew assumed unless noted).
